== Description ==

Games in the hall at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025, with [[Ryan French]] (front right, bald, grey Darth Vader shirt) and [[Ryan Jellison]] (back right, black New Allies shirt). Remaining players unlabeled.
